entries.title: Theme admin list showing Portfolio.
entries.notes: Capture with Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-portfolio installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the Portfolio theme is available for a premium studio or case-study site.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with Portfolio theme.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded studio page with work grid, case studies, services, proof, testimonials, media kit, newsletter, CTA, and footer.
entries.useCase: A studio, consultant, or creator sees how the theme sells work outcomes without overlapping Agency's campaign preset.

entries.title: Portfolio homepage.
entries.notes: Capture work-led hero, case-file proof, selected work, audience path, and enquiry CTA.
entries.useCase: A premium studio reviews whether the first viewport feels like a serious case-study product rather than a basic creative preset.

entries.title: Selected work board.
entries.notes: Capture dense work cards with media treatment, role/scope metadata, outcome labels, and filtering rhythm.
entries.useCase: A visitor can scan relevant work without the theme feeling like a blog, gallery, or Agency services grid.

entries.title: Case-study detail.
entries.notes: Capture outcome ledger, challenge/approach/result sections, scope cards, and next-project CTA.
entries.useCase: A studio proves premium value through measurable work outcomes instead of broad testimonials.

entries.title: Studio capabilities.
entries.notes: Capture studio service cards, engagement shape, process hints, and proof-linked capabilities.
entries.useCase: A visitor understands what can be bought without the theme becoming a local-services page.

entries.title: Media kit and speaking package.
entries.notes: Capture speaking, press, audience, and newsletter paths with compact credibility proof.
entries.useCase: A creator or consultant can sell authority and audience-building without needing a separate knowledge theme.

entries.title: Audience and newsletter path.
entries.notes: Capture newsletter CTA, audience proof, and work-to-subscriber conversion copy.
entries.useCase: A studio checks that audience growth supports the portfolio lane without becoming Knowledge's resource archive.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated for the seeded Portfolio theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator previews a case-study page with the Portfolio theme applied before publishing the theme choice.
